claims.text: His last debunking book appeared a year after his death: 'The UFO enigma: the definitive explanation of the UFO phenomenon', Garden City, N.Y.: Doubleday, 1977, ISBN 0385035969.

claims.sourceText: Internet Archive catalogue records for works by Menzel, returned by https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php with creator 'Menzel, Donald H.', and item metadata at https://archive.org/metadata/ufoenigmadefinit0000menz_f0a5
claims.text: He is one man with two names in the corpus. The Internet Archive's catalogue records give the authorised form of his name on every work as 'Menzel, Donald H. (Donald Howard), 1901-1976', which resolves the batch 05 caption 'Howard Menzel' to the batch 02 'Donald Menzel'.
